name: com.profblu.milesima/milesima
title: Milésima
description: Formula 1 data to the thousandth: live season, results, standings, drivers and history since 1950.

tools.name: get_next_session
tools.description: What is on now or next in Formula 1: the live or next session (Grand Prix, round, circuit, start time in UTC and status), the latest result and the championship leaders (or the champions in the off-season), with the canonical Milésima page of each. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_session_results
tools.description: The classification of a Formula 1 session of any season since 1950: race and sprint (position, driver, team, laps, total time or gap to the winner to the thousandth, points, grid position, status), qualifying (Q1/Q2/Q3 times and who was knocked out) or practice (best lap, gap, laps). From 2023 every session; before 2023 only the race. Marks a classification that is still provisional. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

year.description: Season year (1950 onwards). Omit for the current season.

grand_prix.description: The Grand Prix: its name, country, city or circuit in English, Spanish or Italian (“Monaco”, “Italian Grand Prix”, “Monza”, “Las Vegas”) or its Milésima slug (“las-vegas”).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: The drivers' or constructors' championship of a season (1950 onwards; constructors from 1958): position, points, gap to the leader, wins and podiums, how the title stands and, for constructors, the points of each driver. Optionally as it stood after a given round. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

year.description: Season year (1950 onwards). Omit for the current season.

after_round.description: The standings after this round. Omit for the latest.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Every round of a Formula 1 season (1950 onwards): Grand Prix, circuit and city, weekend dates, race start time in UTC, sprint weekends, cancelled rounds and the winner of each race already run. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

year.description: Season year (1950 onwards). Omit for the current season.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_driver
tools.description: The profile of any Formula 1 driver since 1950: country, date of birth, car number, teams, first and last race, championship years and career figures (starts, wins, podiums, points, titles, fastest laps; poles only from 2023 — before that, starts from first place on the grid), plus the current season. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

driver.description: The driver's name (“Fernando Alonso”, “Senna”, “Kimi Antonelli”) or Milésima slug (“fernando-alonso”).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: The profile of any Formula 1 team or constructor since 1950: seasons, Grands Prix, wins, starts from first place on the grid, podiums, constructors' and drivers' titles, current drivers and the teams it comes from. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

team.description: The team's name (“Ferrari”, “McLaren”, “Red Bull”) or Milésima slug (“red-bull”).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: get_grand_prix_history
tools.description: The history of a circuit since 1950: who won every Grand Prix held there (most recent first, with grid position, race time and fastest lap), who has won the most, the race lap record, length, corners and the next Grand Prix there. Accepts the circuit, its city or the Grand Prix name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

circuit.description: The circuit (“Monza”, “Silverstone”), its city (“Monte Carlo”) or a Grand Prix name (“British Grand Prix”).

limit.description: How many winners, most recent first, 1-80. Default 20.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Milésima's Formula 1 data since 1950 for drivers, teams, circuits, seasons and Grands Prix by name, without accents or capitals, and returns each match with a line of context and its page. Use it when you are not sure of a name. Responds in the requested language (lang: es, en, it).

type.description: Only one kind: driver, team, circuit, season or grand_prix.

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Use the language of the person asking.
